replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Firstly, staff have a life. I don't know how many times I have to say that...

Secondly, mmg was banned literally 5 minutes ago; therefore we do answer reports.

Thirdly, how do you know we weren't reviewing the report? What if we came to a conclusive decision that the accused player wasn't hacking?

Lastly, if you're almost certain that someone is hacking, report them by filing an online report with suffice evidence to prove your report.
